transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… my eating’s been really off. I stopped keeping track of food like I usually do, and I’ve been skipping actual meals—mostly just coffee and protein bars for days. My clothes got loose before I really paid attention to it.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
I don’t think so. I mean… I haven’t really been focused on that. It’s more like I just haven’t been eating much.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah… I guess I have. After the sponsor questioned my judgment, it kind of… knocked the bottom out. I just sat in my apartment feeling hollow and ashamed. I was crying over emails I normally would’ve just dealt with.
Have you lost your appetite?

Yeah… I think so. I just kind of stopped wanting real meals. I’d go days on coffee and protein bars, and I wasn’t even tracking food like I normally do. My clothes started getting loose before I really noticed.
Do you feel fat or overweight right now?
Not really. I don’t… I don’t think about myself that way right now.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah… I guess so. I haven’t really wanted to do the stuff I usually do—hiking, editing photos, even the woodworking thing in the garage. I’ve barely been logging meals either. It’s… not like me.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
Yeah… I have. I started thinking people at work would be better off if I just… didn’t wake up. And after one meeting, I said I should just walk into traffic and be done with it.
Are you thinking about killing yourself right now?

Right now… I don’t know. It’s there, kind of. I keep thinking people at work would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And after that meeting I said I should walk into traffic… I don’t feel good saying that.
Do you intend to kill yourself?

I… I don’t know if I’d call it intent. But I did think everyone at work would be better off if I didn’t wake up, and after that meeting I said I should just walk into traffic. It scared me that I said it.
Do you feel overweight even though other people might say you’re thin?
Not really… I don’t think so. I haven’t been focused on that.
When you look at your body, do you feel fat even if others say you’re thin?
No… I don’t really look at myself that way. I haven’t noticed feeling fat or anything like that.
Have you been eating less because you’re simply not hungry?

Yeah… I guess so. I wasn’t really hungry, or I just didn’t care. I stopped keeping track of food and skipped actual meals for a few days… mostly coffee and protein bars. My clothes got loose before I really noticed.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I haven’t really been paying attention to that.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the day nearly every day?
Yeah… after the sponsor questioned my judgment, I kind of crashed. I sat in my apartment feeling… hollow, I guess. Ashamed. I was crying over emails I normally would’ve just dealt with.
Have you been feeling hopeless?
Yeah… I guess I did. After my sponsor questioned my judgment, it felt like everything just dropped out. I was sitting there feeling hollow and ashamed… crying over emails I normally would’ve handled.
Have these depressed feelings been going on for at least two weeks?
Yeah… more than two weeks. It’s been, I don’t know, around three months since that project thing. I’ve just felt kind of hollow and ashamed… not really interested in much.
Have you been worrying a lot about different things lately?
I don’t know… I mean, I think about things, but I wouldn’t say I’m worrying about a bunch of different stuff all the time. It’s hard to tell.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed that, exactly… maybe I’ve been quieter, but I don’t know about slower.
Have you been trying to lose weight?
No… not on purpose. I just kind of stopped paying attention to eating. Skipped meals, mostly coffee and protein bars. Then my clothes were loose and I hadn’t really noticed until then.
Do you have a strong fear of gaining weight?
No… I don’t think so. I’m not really afraid of gaining weight. I just haven’t been eating much.

Generalized/multidomain worry is not supported, making F41.9 unlikely.
